description: This file defines an index router with multiple command functions for handling index-related data, such as constituents, snapshots, available indices, search, S&P 500 multiples, and sectors. It sets up routing and includes external router dependencies.

methods.name: constituents
methods.description: Fetches index constituents based on provided parameters.

methods.name: snapshots
methods.description: Retrieves current index snapshots grouped by region.

methods.name: available
methods.description: Lists all available indices from a provider.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Filters indices containing a specific query.

methods.name: sp500_multiples
methods.description: Gets historical S&P 500 multiples and Shiller PE ratios.

methods.name: sectors
methods.description: Retrieves sector weightings of an index.
